answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of custody with homomorphic tags, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The cipher test is the live device, the willow test is the locked stake, and the comet test is the graded history no template can fake. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
